visualCharacteristics.purpose: Star-rated customer review cards from review sites (e.g. Trustpilot, Capterra)
visualCharacteristics.layout: review-site logo and label on top, star rating, quote, reviewer name and business; 1/2/3 columns by breakpoint

contentPattern.structure: One row per card; cell 1 optional review-site logo image with optional source label paragraph (e.g. Trustpilot); cell 2 rating paragraph ("5 out of 5 stars", rendered as stars), quote paragraph(s), bold reviewer name paragraph, optional business/role paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for grids of short star-rated customer reviews. For a single large featured testimonial use quote-testimonial instead.
